authority: CLAUDE.md §5 Tier 3, §12.2 status categories, §13.3 no fabricated project facts
_provenance.paragraph_numbering: ¶N per the numbering scheme defined in hand_lift_provenance.json (436 non-empty paragraphs, table cells included).
_provenance.field_mapping: title and mitigation are the draft risk table's Risk and Mitigation columns, verbatim. The draft's single L/I column is split into likelihood and impact (L = low, M = medium, H = high). The draft assigns no risk categories, owners or affected work packages; Phase 6 populates the full risk register.

risk_philosophy.statement: Failure of zero-shot transfer is not project failure. If FIELDWISE establishes that a model trained at MATE cannot reliably transfer to Bulgaria without a defined amount of local calibration, that is itself a significant scientific finding.
